claim: At N=256 (seeds 56/57/58, 4 layers, d_model=64, best-of-5 controls, checkpoints every 10 steps), accel_step persistently formed at steps 100/160/120. Final layer-4 R2 was 0.849/0.896/0.887 against controls 0.680/0.778/0.719, giving margins of 0.169/0.118/0.168. On the threshold-free measure (first checkpoint at half of the run's final margin), formation came at steps 90/80/100, about where the N=64 runs this hypothesis cites formed (80/85/90). Force never beat its control (final margin 0.000-0.020, after a short rise to 0.16-0.19 at steps 10-30 that faded by step 80-110), and val_mse_ratio stayed at 11.3-12.8 (never below 1).
confidence_note: This finding covers only the N=256 arm. The per-seed N=64 formation steps for seeds 56-58 are not in these results, so the paired per-seed differences the hypothesis needs could not be computed. The comparison above uses the earlier, unmatched N=64 values (80/85/90). Against those, the two measures disagree, which the hypothesis's own rules count as inconclusive. On the 0.1-margin bar, N=256 is 10-80 steps later. Seed 57's step-160 crossing is driven by its small final margin (0.118, only just above the bar), which comes from the highest control R2 (0.778). On the half-final-margin measure, N=256 is 80-100, which is within about 10-20 steps of N=64 and points to roughly fixed timing. A raw 0.1 threshold seems to measure each seed's ceiling (set by its control R2) more than when formation happens. Formation also does not occur at a fixed fraction of step-0 val MSE: it falls at 2.3-5.5% of step-0 on the 0.1 bar and 6-9% on the half-final measure, versus about 2-3% reported at N=64. What would change the verdict: joining these runs with the matched N=64 runs on seeds 56-58. If N=64 minus N=256 on the half-final measure is within 10 steps in 2 of 3 seeds, the result moves toward refuted (timing fixed across N, and the raw-threshold gap is a ceiling artifact). If N=256 is 20 or more steps later on both measures in all seeds, the result is supported. All runs completed 300 of 300 steps.

notes.text: Response to review r-20261012-035847-ced3 (issue 1): Accepted. The confidence note was wrong to say the per-seed N=64 values were unavailable: they had been recorded in f-20261012-030203-1224. Joined correctly, the N=256 minus N=64 differences for seeds 56/57/58 are +20/+70/+30 on the 0.1 bar (all 3 >= 20) and +20/+10/+30 on the half-final-margin measure (2 of 3 >= 20). That meets expected_if_true as written ('at least 20 steps later for the same seed'), so 'inconclusive' understated the result. I cannot raise the status, and the replication has to be earned, so this cycle reruns the matched e <= 0.5 pair on fresh seeds 62-64 with 5-step checkpoints and a pre-registered rule: >= 20 steps on both measures in at least 2 of 3 seeds. Correction to the framing in exp-20261012-032843-ab90: its hypothesis said the half-final measure 'suggested roughly equal timing' at e <= 0.5, but the paired gaps were +10 to +30. So the e <= 0.85 null result (f-20261012-034134-5e82) does not show that the e <= 0.5 delay was a ceiling artifact. The correct reading is that the steps_per_orbit delay seen at e <= 0.5 is absent at e <= 0.85, and that difference is currently unexplained. A new question on why is filed in new_questions.

Response to review r-20261012-035847-ced3 (issue 1): Accepted. The N=64 values for seeds 56/57/58 were already in f-20261012-030203-1224: 80/90/90 on the 0.1 bar and 70/70/70 on half-final margin. The paired N=256 minus N=64 differences are +20/+70/+30 on the 0.1 bar and +20/+10/+30 on half-final. That meets the pre-registered expected_if_true (N=256 persistent step >= 20 later in every seed), so the confidence note's 'not available' and the inconclusive verdict were wrong. Statuses can only be corrected downward, so this one stays inconclusive and is not promoted. The correct reading is 'supported on one matched set of seeds, pending replication'. Two corrections to exp-20261012-032843-ab90's framing: (1) the half-final measure at e<=0.5 did not show roughly equal timing; it showed +10 to +30. (2) The null result at e<=0.85 therefore conflicts with the e<=0.5 delay; it does not show that delay was a ceiling artifact. This cycle's matched N=64/N=256 pair on fresh seeds 62-64 at e<=0.5 tests whether the delay replicates. A new question asks whether it depends on eccentricity.
